Calibrate supplied predictions with binary or multiclass Inductive/Cross methods,
or moderated regression. These examples use base R and the installed package.

Start with `vignette("manual-calibration", package = "vennabers")` for the
step-by-step guide. `?vennabers_examples` indexes all four example collections.

## Choose an example

- [Binary precision, loss and event selection](#binary-options)
- [Binary Cross calibration with retained models](#cross-venn-abers)
- [Inductive multiclass one-vs-one](#inductive-ovo)
- [Inductive multiclass one-vs-rest](#inductive-ovr)
- [Cross multiclass calibration](#cross-multiclass)
- [Inductive regression](#inductive-regression)
- [Cross regression](#cross-regression)

## Running an example

Each heading below names an installed script. To inspect and run one:

```{r run-example, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE}
script <- system.file("examples", "binary-options.R", package = "vennabers")
file.show(script)
source(script)
```

Replace the filename to run another script. The listings below show the complete
code without executing it during documentation builds. Sourcing a script runs
its fits and checks; resampling, tuning and composition matrices can take longer
than the introductory guides.

## Binary precision, loss and event selection {#binary-options}

`binary-options.R`: Compare Log/Brier regularization, calibration rounding, class predictions and Cross fold diagnostics.

```{r binary-options, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "binary-options.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```

## Binary Cross calibration with retained models {#cross-venn-abers}

`cross-venn-abers.R`: Fit separate GLMs, retain the corresponding fold models and assess calibrated probabilities on held-out observations.

```{r cross-venn-abers, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "cross-venn-abers.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```

## Inductive multiclass one-vs-one {#inductive-ovo}

`inductive-ovo.R`: Calibrate fixed class probabilities, inspect pair diagnostics and score the coupled class matrix.

```{r inductive-ovo, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "inductive-ovo.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```

## Inductive multiclass one-vs-rest {#inductive-ovr}

`inductive-ovr.R`: Calibrate each class against the rest and assess the final normalized probabilities.

```{r inductive-ovr, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "inductive-ovr.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```

## Cross multiclass calibration {#cross-multiclass}

`cross-multiclass.R`: Supply fold-matched class matrices and reconstruct the OvO/OvR aggregation from binary diagnostics.

```{r cross-multiclass, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "cross-multiclass.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```

## Inductive regression {#inductive-regression}

`inductive-regression.R`: Fit an independent linear model, calibrate numeric predictions and report RMSE/MAE on separate assessment data.

```{r inductive-regression, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "inductive-regression.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```

## Cross regression {#cross-regression}

`cross-regression.R`: Retain matching fold models and inspect the equal-weight merger of regression points and bounds.

```{r cross-regression, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "cross-regression.R", package = "vennabers"))}
```
